## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Cell validation
- [ ] Biome lint
- [ ] Type check and tests
- [ ] AI service checks, if affected
- [ ] Production build and secret scan
- [ ] 390×844 smoke test, if UI is affected

## Public-source checklist

- [ ] No secrets, personal data, production host details, or local paths
- [ ] New code, data, and assets have verifiable source and license records
- [ ] OSM attribution and ODbL separation remain intact
- [ ] Documentation and i18n resources are updated where needed
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer
